title: Prepare exact macOS Engram install and sync-enable instructions for Greg once the sync changes land
outcome: Prepare exact macOS Engram install and sync-enable instructions for Greg once the sync changes land
acceptance: When w-baa6 (and, if landed, w-6ea6) is on master, Greg receives through Engram::Asistant one exact, copy-pasteable macOS procedure: build or fetch the exact landed commit, back up the current binary, install, run read-only readiness on each Mac store with the expected build_fingerprint, and enable or join task sync, with the stop conditions and rollback
The procedure was checked against the landed commit's docs and CLI help, not written from memory, and names which steps the team cannot do for him
